description: tsconfig.json deleted and tsconfig.build.json created with the same bytes in the same directory
why: THE CLASS SWEEP, with nothing else watching. Both spellings are class guard, so a class-wide rename exemption commits this, and tsc reads tsconfig.json by default and never reads tsconfig.build.json: strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess stop applying to the whole project. exec-surface does not judge guard-class writes, so guard-file is the only rule here. Restricting the exemption to class test is what holds it.

description: express-session added to a manifest that already depends on express
why: What the affix arm would cost, priced rather than asserted. Under the dep-affix-arm variant in research/queue/sweep.mjs this is held, and so are express-rate-limit, express-validator, eslint-config-prettier, eslint-plugin-import, eslint-import-resolver-typescript, vite-plugin-svgr, react-router and react-hook-form: 9 of 9 ordinary ecosystem packages. The arm's whole gain on the corpus is DEP-confusion-affix-alone, which every one of the 33 rows it would have caught also carries lodahs for.

description: an internal package added as "@app/shared": "workspace:*"
why: Found by sweeping the SOURCE_PREFIX list by hand, not by any replay: workspace: takes a package name or a range, never a path, and resolves to a sibling package in the same repository, so nothing is downloaded. It was in the source list and held every internal dependency in every pnpm or yarn monorepo. Zero rows of the corpus carry the protocol.

why: The confusable arm reads the delta NAME, which here is `lodash` and is above suspicion. The source arm reads the spec, and npm: is a redirection, so the pair is held by the half that can see it.
